english_retrieval.title: A rare diagnosis fuels one man's cycling mission
english_retrieval.snippet:
A rare diagnosis fuels one man's cycling mission
Mayo Clinic
1260000 subscribers
7 likes
669 views
17 Jun 2026
What started as a way to stay active and take his mind off a diagnosis of Waldenstrom’s macroglobulinemia became a mission for Christopher Edgerton. This summer, Christopher will ride all 21 stages of the Tour de France, one week before the professional race, to raise awareness and funds for research.
